content:
In June this year, Anthropic released its first Mythos-class AI model, Fable 5, for use with Claude. Three months later, Anthropic launched the upgraded Fable 5.1 model, further enhancing Claude's performance.

Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 officially debut today

In Anthropic's positioning, Fable is Claude's most capable model; Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus are positioned as mid-tier, mid-tier, and large-tier respectively, ranking below Fable.

Anthropic stated: "Claude Fable 5.1 has set a new standard in coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks." The company noted that the new model achieves a higher performance level compared to Fable 5.

Anthropic also pointed out that when Fable 5.1 is set to low or medium computational effort, it can "achieve performance comparable to or better than Fable 5 at lower cost."

More information from Anthropic is as follows:

In addition to Fable 5.1, Anthropic has simultaneously launched Mythos 5.1 for users with Mythos access.

Anthropic explained: "Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are the same model, but with different levels of safety protections. Fable 5.1 is the general-purpose version, while Mythos 5.1 is available only through our trusted access programme; its safety protections are specifically designed for work in cybersecurity and life sciences."

The pricing information for Fable 5.1 is as follows:

Regarding pricing, Anthropic stated that it has "reduced the cost of Fable 5.1 cached reads (i.e., when the model reuses already-processed context), applicable to token-based billing scenarios such as our API." The company noted that this move "significantly lowers the overall cost of running the model." Beyond this, pricing remains unchanged from Fable 5.

For more details, please refer to the official announcement article here.
